Question B-001-007-004.

Why the correct answer is right: Broadcasts intended for the general public are not permitted as one-way amateur transmissions.

Why the distractors are wrong:
- sourceIndex 1: "Radio control commands to model craft": Model-control commands are a permitted one-way use.
- sourceIndex 2: "Brief transmissions to make adjustments to the station": Short adjustment transmissions are allowed, so this is not the prohibited case.
- sourceIndex 3: "Morse code practice": Morse practice is a permitted one-way communication in the amateur service.
